title: Moon Eye Surreal Portrait
description: A large detailed human eye with a teal iris and long lashes is centered in the composition, with a textured full moon containing another smaller green eye embedded in its surface directly above it. The background features a swirling cosmic gradient of deep blues, purples and oranges, decorated with floating hearts, stars, and dripping teal text reading '1000 Paintings'.
prompt: surreal cosmic painting featuring a giant realistic human eye with vibrant teal iris and detailed lashes in the center, a textured full moon with another smaller green eye embedded within it floating above the main eye, swirling galaxy background in deep blues purples and fiery orange, floating pink hearts and stars, dripping stylized text '1000 Paintings' below the eye, mystical and ethereal atmosphere
